rect.title: A1 Build inventory: s30/docs/01-inventory.md lists every binary, pak family and tool with versions
A2 Dependency map: s30/docs/02-architecture.md: injection, bridge, dedi, assets
A3 Signature census: pattern_census.py run on S21 DX11/DX12, S3 dedi, S30
A4 String/param diff: strings_diff.py: netmsg, convar, launch-param, script-native families
B1 S30 netmsg ID map: every S21 msgArray slot matched to an S30 slot (GetType + RFB body)
B2 Recv table diff: S30 client class/recvprop dump diffed against S21
B3 Script native diff: S30 native registration table dumped; Flowstate client/UI calls checked
B4 Asset version census: per-type asset versions of S30 paks vs what the S3 dedi parses
B5 Connect/signon trace: S30 connectionless packets and signon sequence documented
B6 Integrity checks: S30 code-integrity / import checks found or ruled out
C1 Loader injects: patched S30 copy loads loader.dll -> client_s30.dll; S30_EarlyInit and SDK_Init both log
C2 Offline + net guard: no non-loopback connection during boot (guard log + netstat)
C3 Core detours: tier0/tier1/convar/cmd/filesystem resolve and attach on S30
C4 Main menu: client reaches the main menu with SDK console
C5 Script VM hooks: client/UI VMs compile Flowstate scripts without errors
C6 Bridge symbols: every NetObs symbol resolves and is verified on S30
D1 Challenge/connect: dedi logs the S30 client as connected
D2 Signon complete: client reaches SIGNONSTATE_FULL
D3 First snapshot: client decodes snapshots without desync
D4 Entities replicate: player, weapons, props created and moving
D5 Script remotes: S2C/C2S ScriptRemote calls run on both ends
D6 10-min session: 10 minutes in game, no kick, no crash
D7 Disconnect/rejoin: disconnect and reconnect cleanly
E1 Server closure: list of S30 assets the dedi must load for the target content
E2 Models -> dedi: converted mdl load on the dedi (sample, then batch)
E3 Anims -> dedi: arig/aseq convert with R5-AnimConv -i 30 -o 3, clips play
E4 BSP -> dedi: bspconv -dedi output loads, collision matches
E5 Dedi paks + VPK: RePak/revpk outputs load with zero missing-asset errors
F1 Launch scripts: one command starts dedi + S30 client from the workspace
F2 S21 regression: S21 client + dedi still work with the unchanged install
F3 Soak test: 60-minute session, logs clean
F4 Test report: tests/ results with logs

svg.text: * a signature counts when it matches the S30 image exactly once; that does not prove it found the same function (see verified). S30.1 R5pc_r5-301 CL11570498. 2026-10-25 21:33 UTC
